4.0L Naturally Aspirated V8 • Complete Swap Package

Complete 1UZ-FE Non-VVT-i swap package including the engine, transmission, factory ECU, and factory engine wiring harness.

Swap-oriented package. Vehicle-specific installation requirements vary by chassis. Verify vehicle year, make, model, original engine, transmission, and drivetrain before ordering.

ENGINE OVERVIEW

The Toyota 1UZ-FE Non-VVT-i is a 4.0L naturally aspirated V8 known for smooth power delivery, durable construction, reliability, and strong engine-swap potential.

This complete swap package includes the core drivetrain and electronic components required for a 1UZ-FE swap application: the engine, transmission, factory ECU, and factory engine wiring harness.

PACKAGE INCLUDES

• Toyota 1UZ-FE Non-VVT-i 4.0L V8 Engine
• Compatible Transmission
• Factory ECU
• Factory Engine Wiring Harness

ENGINE SPECIFICATIONS

• Engine: Toyota 1UZ-FE
• Configuration: V8
• Displacement: 4.0L / 3,968 cc
• Aspiration: Naturally Aspirated
• Valve System: Non-VVT-i
• Valvetrain: DOHC
• Factory Output: Approximately 250-260 HP
• Fuel System: Electronic Fuel Injection
• Fuel Type: Gasoline
• Cooling: Liquid Cooled
• Manufacturer: Toyota
• Application: Engine Swap / Replacement / Performance Build

ENGINE GENERATION

First-Generation Toyota 1UZ-FE Non-VVT-i. Introduced in 1989 and used throughout the 1990s.

The production year of this individual unit is not documented and is not represented as a specific year.

Mileage: N/A / Not Verified

PERFORMANCE & BUILD POTENTIAL

The factory Non-VVT-i 1UZ-FE produces approximately 250-260 HP, depending on the original application and specification.

For builders targeting approximately 300 HP, the 1UZ-FE provides a strong platform for a naturally aspirated performance build with appropriate supporting upgrades and ECU tuning.

300 HP TARGET

A 300 HP build may require appropriate upgrades to:

• Intake system
• Exhaust system
• Fuel system
• ECU calibration
• ECU tuning
• Supporting engine components

300+ HP POTENTIAL

Higher-output configurations are possible depending on the engine condition, supporting components, fuel system, intake and exhaust setup, ECU calibration, tuning, and overall build specification.

Important: 300 HP is a build target, not the factory-rated output of the stock engine.

COMPATIBLE APPLICATIONS & SWAP PLATFORMS

ORIGINAL TOYOTA / LEXUS APPLICATIONS

The 1UZ-FE was factory-installed in applications including:

• 1989-1994 Lexus LS 400
• 1989-1994 Toyota Celsior
• 1990-1995 Toyota Crown Majesta
• 1991-1997 Toyota Soarer
• 1991-1997 Lexus SC 400

These are original applications for the 1UZ-FE platform. Compatibility with a specific vehicle should still be confirmed based on the exact engine and drivetrain configuration.

COMMON TOYOTA SWAP PLATFORMS

The 1UZ-FE is commonly used for custom swaps in:

• Toyota Supra
• Toyota Cressida
• Toyota Crown
• Toyota Chaser
• Toyota Mark II
• Toyota Cresta
• Toyota Soarer
• Toyota Hilux
• Toyota Pickup

Vehicle-specific transmission mounting, adaptation, or linkage components may be required depending on the chassis — the transmission itself is included in this package. Engine mounting, wiring, ECU, cooling, exhaust, fuel, driveshaft, and accessory requirements may also apply.

LEXUS SWAP PLATFORMS

Common Lexus-based applications include:

• Lexus IS
• Lexus GS
• Lexus SC

Custom RWD vehicles and project cars may also use the 1UZ-FE where appropriate.

No vehicle outside the original factory applications should be represented as a guaranteed bolt-in fit.

24-MONTH LIMITED WARRANTY

records.description:
Old Man Emu front upper control arms for the Toyota Land Cruiser 200 Series, boxed as a pair.

Lifting an independent-front-suspension vehicle pushes its caster and camber outside the factory range, and the factory alignment cams can run out of adjustment. OME's arms are geometry-corrected for a 2 in lift and bring the cams back into a usable range.

OME quotes an increase of +2.5 to +3.5 degrees of caster and up to 1.5 degrees of additional negative camber (approximate figures). Have a wheel alignment done after fitting. With aftermarket wheels and tires, check fender clearance.

The arms use forged ball-joint housings and eyelets, a heavy-duty greasable ball joint, maintenance-free GIIRO bushings, mounts for the OE ABS wiring and ARB's Integrit powder coat.

They are tested to meet VSB14, the Australian standard for vehicle modifications, and are designed and manufactured in Australia.

Specifications

Manufacturer: Old Man Emu (ARB)
Position: Front upper
Quantity: Pair
Caster change: +2.5° to +3.5° (approx.)
Camber change: Up to 1.5° additional negative (approx.)
Designed for: 2 in lift
Part number: UCA0001

records.warrantyTerms: Subject to the DrivoraParts Warranty Policy and the manufacturer's own warranty terms. Excludes installation labour and damage from incorrect fitment.
records.description:
ARB Air Locker RD232 for the Toyota 8.9 in Rear, 32-Spline, 12-Bolt Ring Gear — 2016–2023 Toyota Tacoma.

An ARB Air Locker is a selectable locking differential. Flick the dash switch and compressed air locks the differential gears, so both axle shafts turn with the ring gear and each wheel gets full drive. Switched off, it behaves like a normal open differential, so on-road driving and driveline wear are unaffected.

ARB's two-piece design has few moving parts, a patented timed locking mechanism for strength and fast unlocking, and a steel-reinforced elastomer-bonded seal built for temperature extremes. It can be engaged at any speed.

The kit includes the Air Locker differential, activation switch, solenoid valve, air line and bulkhead fitting. It needs an air compressor to operate, sold separately; ARB's own compressors are listed in this category. Fitting means removing the carrier and setting up the ring and pinion, so it's a job for a workshop with differential experience.

ARB matches each Air Locker to an axle, spline count and, for some axles, a gear-ratio range. Check your axle tag against the specifications below. The vehicle list is ARB's own application table for RD232.

Manufacturer: ARB 4x4 Accessories

Axle: Toyota 8.9 in

Axle shaft diameter: 1.37 in
Gear ratio: All
Part number: RD232

Highlights

Full locking on demand, open differential when off

records.description:
Old Man Emu Nitrocharger Plus integrated suspension kit 1006K for the 2016–2023 Toyota Tacoma.

OME sells integrated kits with the shocks and springs already matched, tuned for how much weight the vehicle carries. Heavy accessories slowly compress a suspension that wasn't built for them, and that sag shows up as poor ride and lost clearance. Picking the kit rated for your weight avoids it.

This kit is for the front and rear. The load figures are the added weight each end is rated to carry at the stated lift. Front: 0 lb means a stock front end, while 220–330 lb suits a heavier front such as a steel bumper and winch. Rear: the constant load carried in the bed or cargo area, such as drawers, a canopy or camping gear.

The kit uses OME's Nitrocharger Plus struts and shocks: a twin-tube design with a heavy-gauge steel reserve tube that protects the internals in rough terrain. A 5-position spring seat, with coil seat spacers included, lets you tune front ride height to your setup.

A wheel alignment is required after fitting.

records.description:
Old Man Emu Nitrocharger Plus integrated suspension kit 3003K for the 2022-on Toyota Tundra.

OME sells integrated kits with the shocks and springs already matched, tuned for how much weight the vehicle carries. Heavy accessories slowly compress a suspension that wasn't built for them, and that sag shows up as poor ride and lost clearance. Picking the kit rated for your weight avoids it.

This kit is for the front and rear. The load figures are the added weight each end is rated to carry at the stated lift. Front: 0 lb means a stock front end, while 220–330 lb suits a heavier front such as a steel bumper and winch. Rear: the constant load carried in the bed or cargo area, such as drawers, a canopy or camping gear.

The kit uses OME's Nitrocharger Plus struts and shocks: a twin-tube design with a heavy-gauge steel reserve tube that protects the internals in rough terrain. A 5-position spring seat, with coil seat spacers included, lets you tune front ride height to your setup.

A wheel alignment is required after fitting.

records.description:
Old Man Emu MT64 integrated suspension kit 2134K for the 2025-on Toyota 4Runner.

OME sells integrated kits with the shocks and springs already matched, tuned for how much weight the vehicle carries. Heavy accessories slowly compress a suspension that wasn't built for them, and that sag shows up as poor ride and lost clearance. Picking the kit rated for your weight avoids it.

This kit is for the front and rear. The load figures are the added weight each end is rated to carry at the stated lift. Front: 0 lb means a stock front end, while 220–330 lb suits a heavier front such as a steel bumper and winch. Rear: the constant load carried in the bed or cargo area, such as drawers, a canopy or camping gear.

The kit uses OME's MT64 monotube shocks, with a 2.8 in aluminum body that holds more oil and sheds heat far faster than steel. The front is a complete coilover assembly for direct bolt-in fitment, with a 6-position snap ring that sets front lift anywhere from 1.75 to 3 in. Digressive valving reacts quickly to changing surfaces, and a hydraulic end-zone top-out cushions full extension.

A wheel alignment is required after fitting.

OME sells integrated kits with the shocks and springs already matched, tuned for how much weight the vehicle carries. Heavy accessories slowly compress a suspension that wasn't built for them, and that sag shows up as poor ride and lost clearance. Picking the kit rated for your weight avoids it.

This kit is for the front only. The load figures are the added weight each end is rated to carry at the stated lift. Front: 0 lb means a stock front end, while 220–330 lb suits a heavier front such as a steel bumper and winch. Rear: the constant load carried in the bed or cargo area, such as drawers, a canopy or camping gear.

The kit uses OME's BP-51 internal-bypass coilovers and shocks. Damping is position-sensitive, and there are 10 levels each of compression and rebound, adjustable on the vehicle. A remote reservoir adds oil for cooling on long off-road sections, and the 6061 aluminum body has a type III hard-anodised finish.

A wheel alignment is required after fitting.

Manufacturer: Old Man Emu (ARB)
Kit: BP-51

Coverage: front only

records.description:
Old Man Emu MT64 integrated suspension kit 2117K for the 2024 Lexus GX550 / Toyota Land Cruiser.

OME sells integrated kits with the shocks and springs already matched, tuned for how much weight the vehicle carries. Heavy accessories slowly compress a suspension that wasn't built for them, and that sag shows up as poor ride and lost clearance. Picking the kit rated for your weight avoids it.

This kit is for the front and rear. The load figures are the added weight each end is rated to carry at the stated lift. Front: 0 lb means a stock front end, while 220–330 lb suits a heavier front such as a steel bumper and winch. Rear: the constant load carried in the bed or cargo area, such as drawers, a canopy or camping gear.

The kit uses OME's MT64 monotube shocks, with a 2.8 in aluminum body that holds more oil and sheds heat far faster than steel. The front is a complete coilover assembly for direct bolt-in fitment, with a 6-position snap ring that sets front lift anywhere from 1.75 to 3 in. Digressive valving reacts quickly to changing surfaces, and a hydraulic end-zone top-out cushions full extension.

A wheel alignment is required after fitting.

OME sells integrated kits with the shocks and springs already matched, tuned for how much weight the vehicle carries. Heavy accessories slowly compress a suspension that wasn't built for them, and that sag shows up as poor ride and lost clearance. Picking the kit rated for your weight avoids it.

This kit is for the front and rear. The load figures are the added weight each end is rated to carry at the stated lift. Front: 0 lb means a stock front end, while 220–330 lb suits a heavier front such as a steel bumper and winch. Rear: the constant load carried in the bed or cargo area, such as drawers, a canopy or camping gear.

The kit uses OME's MT64 monotube shocks, with a 2.8 in aluminum body that holds more oil and sheds heat far faster than steel. The front is a complete coilover assembly for direct bolt-in fitment, with a 6-position snap ring that sets front lift anywhere from 1.75 to 3 in. Digressive valving reacts quickly to changing surfaces, and a hydraulic end-zone top-out cushions full extension.

Upper control arms are included to correct front alignment geometry at the raised ride height.

A wheel alignment is required after fitting.

Specifications

Kit: MT64 with upper control arms

Coverage: front and rear
Part number: 2118K

records.name: Safari ARMAX Snorkel for 2010–2023 Toyota 4Runner — SS450HP
records.fitment: Toyota 4Runner 2010–2023 (2.7L, 4L). Vehicle-specific — fits this application only.
records.warrantyTerms: Subject to the DrivoraParts Warranty Policy and the manufacturer's own warranty terms. Excludes installation labour and damage from incorrect fitment.
records.description:
Safari ARMAX snorkel for the 2010–2023 Toyota 4Runner.

A snorkel moves the engine's air intake from a low, exposed spot under the hood up to roof height, where the air is cooler, cleaner and drier. On a dusty track that means less dirt reaching the filter; in water it means the intake is nowhere near the waterline.

Safari moulds these from UV-stable cross-linked polyethylene, and each is designed for one vehicle, so it follows the A-pillar and the guard properly rather than being trimmed to fit. Fasteners and mounting brackets are included, and ARB lists a lifetime warranty on the snorkel body.

This is the ARMAX model: a high-flow design with a 4 in air ram intake, which ARB rates at 10% higher CFM than other brands.

A snorkel raises the intake; it does not by itself make a vehicle waterproof. Diff, gearbox and transfer case breathers, and the electrics, all need attention before deep water.

Specifications

Manufacturer: Safari (ARB)
Range: ARMAX
Material: UV-stable cross-linked polyethylene
Includes: Fasteners and mounting brackets
Applications: Toyota 4Runner 2010–2023 (2.7L, 4L)
Part number: SS450HP

Highlights

Raises the air intake to roof height
Vehicle-specific moulding, not a universal kit
ARMAX high-flow body with 4 in air ram
Fasteners and brackets included

Warranty
Lifetime Warranty (snorkel body)

records.warrantyTerms: Subject to the DrivoraParts Warranty Policy and the manufacturer's own warranty terms. Excludes installation labour and damage from incorrect fitment.
records.description:
Safari VSPEC snorkel for the 2010–2014 Toyota FJ Cruiser.

A snorkel moves the engine's air intake from a low, exposed spot under the hood up to roof height, where the air is cooler, cleaner and drier. On a dusty track that means less dirt reaching the filter; in water it means the intake is nowhere near the waterline.

Safari moulds these from UV-stable cross-linked polyethylene, and each is designed for one vehicle, so it follows the A-pillar and the guard properly rather than being trimmed to fit. Fasteners and mounting brackets are included, and ARB lists a lifetime warranty on the snorkel body.

This is the VSPEC model, with high-flow ducting sized to supply more air than the engine needs, and sealing aimed squarely at keeping dust and water out.

A snorkel raises the intake; it does not by itself make a vehicle waterproof. Diff, gearbox and transfer case breathers, and the electrics, all need attention before deep water.

records.description:
ARB engineered recovery point for the left-hand side of the Toyota Land Cruiser.

Factory tow hooks are for towing a vehicle on flat ground, not for snatching one out of a bog. There is no industry standard covering them, which is exactly the confusion ARB set out to fix with an engineered, vehicle-specific recovery point.

The issues with generic tow points are mounting locations nobody has tested, uncertainty about which shackle and strap to pair with them, and their inability to handle the loads of an angled pull. ARB rates each recovery point as part of a matched recovery chain.

This is the vehicle-specific point for the Toyota Land Cruiser 2024–2026, left-hand side. It is sold individually.

records.name: S&B Cold Air Intake, Cotton Cleanable — 2024–2026 Toyota Land Cruiser, 2.4L — 75-5220

records.warrantyTerms: Subject to the DrivoraParts Warranty Policy and the manufacturer's own warranty terms. Excludes installation labour and damage from incorrect fitment.
records.description:
S&B cold air intake with oiled cotton gauze media for the 2024–2026 Toyota Land Cruiser, 2.4L.

The factory airbox is a compromise between airflow, noise and cost, and the filter inside it is sized to the same compromise. An intake designed around airflow gives the engine an easier breath — which shows up as throttle response before it shows up on a dyno.

What separates a designed intake from an open filter on a pipe is the housing. A sealed box keeps the filter drawing cool air from outside the engine bay rather than the hot air sitting around it, and it keeps the filter out of the weather and the debris.

Filtration is the half of the equation that gets ignored. More airflow is easy if you do not care what comes through with it; the engineering is in improving airflow while still catching what would otherwise go into the engine.

This is the Cotton Cleanable version. The media is oiled cotton gauze: at service it is washed, dried and re-oiled, and it goes back in rather than being thrown away. It is the long-standing choice, and the one to pick if you are happy to oil a filter.

This is S&B's intake for the 2024–2026 Toyota Land Cruiser, 2.4L, part number 75-5220.

Specifications

Manufacturer: S&B Filters
Product: Cold Air Intake

Housing: Sealed intake box
Application: 2024–2026 Toyota Land Cruiser, 2.4L
Part number: 75-5220

Highlights

Sealed housing draws cool air, not engine bay heat
Oiled cotton gauze — washable and re-oilable
More airflow without giving up filtration

Filtration is the half of the equation that gets ignored. More airflow is easy if you do not care what comes through with it; the engineering is in improving airflow while still catching what would otherwise go into the engine.

This is the Cotton Cleanable version. The media is oiled cotton gauze: at service it is washed, dried and re-oiled, and it goes back in rather than being thrown away. It is the long-standing choice, and the one to pick if you are happy to oil a filter.

This is S&B's intake for the 2012–2015 Toyota Tacoma 4.0L, part number 75-5100.

Bilstein 5100 Shocks Set for the 1990–1997 Toyota Land Cruiser 80 4WD w/2-2.5 in lift, package contains 4 shocks.

Bilstein builds monotube gas dampers: one tube carries the oil, and a floating piston separates it from a nitrogen charge. That layout resists the foaming that fades a twin-tube damper on a long corrugated road, and it sheds heat better because the oil sits against the outer wall.

Package Contains 4 Shocks. You'll be getting two front and two rear shock absorbers. The front and rear carry different part numbers — 24-238878 (front) / 24-238885 (rear).

records.description:
TS Booster V3.0 Toyota (Check application listings), BD part 1057939.

A drive-by-wire throttle pedal has a deliberate softness built into it, and on a heavy vehicle that reads as lag: you press, and the engine thinks about it.

The TS Booster amplifies the signal between the pedal and the ECM so the same pedal travel asks for more, sooner. It does not change what the engine can make — it changes how quickly it is asked for it.

It uses the factory connectors, so installation is plug-in rather than cut-and-splice.
